question: Câu 1: ______ it not been for the marketing strategy, our firm’s profits would not have increased.
options: Were
Should
Had
Has
explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + V3, S + would have + V3.

question: Câu 2: They plan to get a spacecraft ______ Mars next year.
options: exploring
explore
explored
to explore
explanation: get sb/sth to V = thuê/nhờ ai/cái gì làm gì.

question: Câu 3: The engine starts to ______ a loud sound when you press this button.
options: discharge
release
launch
emit
explanation: emit = phát ra (âm thanh).

question: Câu 4: Parents who are waiting outside now ______ worried.
options: will appear
appear
are appearing
appeared
explanation: appear (trạng thái) + now → hiện tại đơn.

question: Câu 5: Students often ______ that college life is filled with excitement, but the reality tells a different story.
options: draw the attention
give an opinion
get the impression
confirm the view
explanation: get the impression = có ấn tượng rằng.

question: Câu 6: You ______ Tony at the concert last night. He was at home doing homework.
options: needn’t have seen
mustn’t have seen
can’t have seen
shouldn’t have seen
explanation: can’t have + V3 = không thể đã làm gì trong quá khứ.

question: Câu 7: Phillips consumes fast food regularly, ______ makes him gain weight.
options: that
which
whose
who
explanation: which thay thế cả mệnh đề phía trước.

question: Câu 8: The poor slum ______ of the city were most affected by the pandemic.
options: dwellers
peers
agents
settlers
explanation: slum dwellers = cư dân khu ổ chuột.

question: Câu 9: He’s a(n) ______ tour guide who has a wealth of experience in the tourist industry.
options: relevant
effective
formal
qualified
explanation: qualified = đủ trình độ, có chuyên môn.

question: Câu 10: When ______ in the open air, fossil fuels like coal can increase the amount of greenhouse gases.
options: be burnt
burning
burnt
having been burnt
explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề bị động: When + V3.

question: Câu 11: He replenished his glass and then continued with the story.
options: repeated
renewed
refilled
restored
explanation: replenish = refill = đổ đầy lại.

question: Câu 12: The old theatre has to be pulled down for safety reasons.
options: harmed
demolished
spoiled
ruined
explanation: pull down = demolish = phá dỡ.

question: Câu 13: Sarah deliberately placed all the books in the box before giving them away.
options: intentionally
carelessly
slowly
accidentally
explanation: deliberately <> carelessly.

question: Câu 14: A firm’s future prosperity depends largely on its employee’s commitment.
options: state of being affluent
feeling of insecurity
absence of innovation
lack of success
explanation: prosperity <> lack of success.

question: Câu 15: David: How are you doing? Sam: __________
options: I'm doing the shopping.
It was a great experience.
I'm fine, thanks.
I'm going to the cinema.
explanation: How are you doing? → I'm fine, thanks.

question: Câu 16: James: How about visiting the city library this weekend? Ngoc: __________
options: I don't think so.
I'm afraid so.
That sounds like a great idea!
I'd love to, but I'll check it out.
explanation: Đồng ý với lời đề nghị.

question: Câu 17: Tom: I heard you finished your project early! Lisa: Yeah, I did. __________
options: I just wanted to get it done and not leave it hanging over my head.
I just wanted to get it done and not take it into account.
I just wanted to complete it and not think on my feet.
I just wanted to complete it and not have a bee in my bonnet.
explanation: leave something hanging over one’s head = để việc gì treo lơ lửng trong đầu.

question: Câu 18: Liam: Do you want help with the project, or would you prefer to do it alone? Tom: __________
options: I'm still figuring out how to tackle it.
I'd prefer to help you, if it's all right.
I appreciate the offer, but I think I can handle it solo.
It's a tricky project, so I'd rather not discuss it right now.
explanation: Từ chối lịch sự và tự tin làm một mình.

question: Câu 19: a. Is it easy to spot? b. Yes, you can't miss it. There's a big clock tower right next to the station. c. Could you tell me how to get to the train station? d. Sure! It's about a 10-minute walk from here. Just go straight and take the second left.
options: c – b – d – a
c – d – a – b
a – b – c – d
a – d – c – b
explanation: Thứ tự hỏi đường logic: hỏi → chỉ đường → hỏi dễ tìm không → xác nhận.

question: Câu 20: a. Right, tour guides often explain this unique tradition during the city tours. b. Why do people light lanterns along the riverbank every evening? c. Oh, the lantern festival takes place here, doesn't it? d. By doing so, they honour their ancestors in a peaceful way.
options: b – d – c – a
b – a – c – d
c – a – b – d
c – d – b – a
explanation: Hỏi lý do → giải thích → nhận ra lễ hội → xác nhận.

question: Câu 21: a. Definitely! Start by focusing on a balanced diet... b. I should try that. Anything else... c. That sounds good. What about exercise? d. Don't forget about sleep... e. Regular exercise is key... f. I've been thinking about making some changes... Any tips?
options: f – d – c – a – b – e
f – e – b – d – c – a
f – a – b – e – c – d
f – a – c – e – b – d
explanation: Hỏi tips → diet → hỏi exercise → trả lời exercise → hỏi thêm → sleep.

question: Câu 22: a. Remind yourself why you started... b. I've been struggling to stay motivated... c. I set small goals... d. How do you stay focused? e. I should give that a try! What about when things get really tough? f. Try breaking your tasks into smaller steps...
options: d – c – b – a – e – f
b – f – d – c – e – a
d – c – e – f – b – a
b – a – e – c – d – f
explanation: Hỏi lời khuyên → chia nhỏ task → hỏi cách tập trung → trả lời → hỏi khi khó → nhắc lý do bắt đầu.

question: Câu 23: As soon as the rain started, people rushed to find shelter.
options: Hardly had the rain begun than people hurried to seek shelter.
The moment the rain poured down did people waste no time finding cover.
No sooner had the rain started than people hurried to take refuge from it.
Once the rain started, people slowly moved to find the nearest shelter.
explanation: No sooner had + S + V3 than...

question: Câu 24: The movie was so captivating that no one wanted it to end.
options: It was such a captivating movie that no one wanted it to end.
The movie was too captivating for no one to want it to end.
Everyone was disappointed when the captivating movie ended.
No one wanted to watch the movie again because it was so captivating.
explanation: so + adj + that = such + a/an + adj + N + that.

question: Câu 25: Digital learning tools might be more effective for students than traditional textbooks.
options: Traditional textbooks are probably not as effective for students as digital learning tools.
Traditional textbooks are definitely better for students than digital learning tools.
Traditional textbooks are certainly more effective for students than digital learning tools.
Traditional textbooks are definitely less effective for students than digital learning tools.
explanation: might = probably not as... as.

question: Câu 26: The feedback on his project gave Mark a real sense of accomplishment.
options: Mark felt a strong sense of achievement from the feedback on his project.
Mark accomplished his project, which gave him useful feedback.
The feedback on his project had a clear impact on Mark's achievement.
Mark's project was very satisfactory according to the feedback.
explanation: sense of accomplishment = sense of achievement.

question: Câu 27: His persistence and dedication led to his winning the prestigious award. This was a culmination of many years of hard work.
options: After many years of dedication, he won the prestigious award, demonstrating his persistence.
Winning the prestigious award was the result of his continuous effort over several years.
He won the prestigious award through many years of his perseverance and dedication to it.
A prestigious award was given to him after years of hard work and decisiveness.
explanation: Giữ đúng quan hệ kết quả của nhiều năm nỗ lực.

question: Câu 28: The lights are flickering. A power outage might be imminent.
options: A power outage is likely since the lights are flickering.
The lights might flicker, but it doesn't necessarily mean a power outage is coming.
Flickering lights always indicate a power outage is about to occur.
It's possible the lights are flickering due to a minor issue, not a power outage.
explanation: might be imminent → is likely.

question: Câu 29: He didn't have much experience. This hindered his ability to secure a promotion.
options: Gaining experience would have improved his chances of getting a promotion.
Lack of experience was a key factor in his difficulty with securing a promotion.
If he had experience, he would likely be promoted.
Experience is not as important as other factors for securing a promotion.
explanation: Lack of experience was a key factor...

question: Câu 30: I can choose to work from home or commute to the office. I prefer the former option.
options: I would rather work from home than commute to the office.
I plan to commute to the office rather than work from home.
Working from home is less preferable than commuting to the office.
I will consider commuting to the office before deciding to work from home.
explanation: prefer the former = would rather... than...

question: Câu 31: Some cities are trying... with cleaner (31) ________ of transportation, like bicycles.
options: channels
means
methods
routes
explanation: means of transportation = phương tiện giao thông.

question: Câu 32: Paris was already on a yearlong journey to (32) ________ away with cars in the city centre...
options: keep
take
move
do
explanation: do away with = loại bỏ.

question: Câu 33: Cycling has boomed even more in recent years, (33) ________ set up during the coronavirus pandemic...
options: spurred in part by new bike lanes
to be spurred in part by new bike lanes
been spurred in part by new bike lanes
having been spurred in part by new bike lanes
explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ bị động → V3.

question: Câu 34: The percentage of trips taken by bicycle within Paris more than (34) ________ between 2020 and 2024...
options: had been doubled
doubled
doubling
were doubled
explanation: more than doubled = tăng hơn gấp đôi.

question: Câu 35: ... new traffic light patterns (35) ________.
options: where cyclists and public transit are prioritised
that prioritise cyclists and public transit
which have prioritised cyclists and public transit
whose cyclists and public transit will be prioritised
explanation: where = tại đó (các mẫu đèn giao thông ưu tiên...).

question: Câu 36: The word ‘that’ in paragraph 1 refers to ______?
options: global climate change
techniques and modifications
the natural processes
ecological factors
explanation: that = the natural processes.

question: Câu 37: What is the main topic of paragraph 2?
options: The special role of irrigation in agriculture
The negative effects of irrigation on the environment
The consequences of large-scale water depletion
The impacts of poisonous soil conditions on freshwater
explanation: Đoạn 2 nói về tác động tiêu cực của tưới tiêu.

question: Câu 38: Which of the following is mentioned in paragraph 2?
options: Human water consumption makes up 70 percent of agriculture.
There will be an increase of 15 percent of water consumption by 2050.
Irrigation can cause some areas to become flooded.
Ground water will run out as a result of water diversion of any kind.
explanation: areas... can become waterlogged.

question: Câu 39: What do synthetic fertilisers NOT do?
options: They increase reactive nitrogen levels.
They help increase crop yields.
They turn nutrients into pollutants.
They make modern agriculture less productive.
explanation: Chúng giúp tăng sản lượng, không làm kém hiệu quả.

question: Câu 40: Which of the following would the author most likely support?
options: Without changes to current farming methods, it is difficult to strike a balance between feeding the population and preserving the environment.
There is a growing conflict between the need for increased agricultural productivity and the radical changes to the existing agricultural practices.
Humans are mainly responsible for taking care of soil health, so they need to adopt better agriculture practices.
Food demand is expected to grow exponentially, so preserving ecological health should be a top priority.
explanation: Cần thay đổi phương pháp canh tác để cân bằng.

question: Câu 41: What does the word ‘it’ in paragraph 1 refer to?
options: a mental-health crisis
her controversial book
an adapted excerpt
a generation
explanation: it = a mental-health crisis.

question: Câu 42: What does paragraph 3 mainly discuss?
options: Twenge’s concern about teens’ excessive use of phones
Twenge’s awareness about screen time and well-being
A clear link between screen time and happiness levels
The limitations and criticisms of Jean Twenge's study
explanation: Đoạn 3 nói về hạn chế và chỉ trích nghiên cứu của Twenge.

question: Câu 43: The word navigate in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to ______.
options: transform
overcome
struggle
reject
explanation: navigate = overcome (vượt qua).

question: Câu 44: Which of the following best paraphrases this sentence: “Some have accused her work of oversimplifying or overlooking data that may tell a slightly different story.”
options: Some critics have argued that her research fails to focus on important data that may suggest otherwise.
Her work has been criticised for simplifying or disregarding small details that might offer a different narrative.
Her study has been claimed by critics to simplify or ignore data that could present a somewhat different perspective.
Some researchers have blamed her for not taking relevant data into account, which prevents it from fully reflecting the complete picture.
explanation: Diễn đạt đúng nhất ý oversimplifying or overlooking.

question: Câu 45: Which of the following would the author most likely support?
options: Recent research might unfairly focus on technology as the primary cause of a drop in teenagers’ mental well-being.
Amanda Lenhart acknowledges that excessive use of electronic devices can have an adverse impact on teenagers’ mental health.
The frequent use of technology is to blame for a decline in the quality of teenagers’ mental health.
The effects of electronic devices on adults and teenagers should not be studied separately.
explanation: Nghiên cứu đang biến công nghệ thành ‘scapegoat’.

question: Câu 46: You are in a new class... What should you say to join a group?
options: Can anyone tell me what the project is about?
This class project looks exciting, but I haven't been assigned to a group.
The class project seems important, and I'd like to help out.
I'd like to be part of a group. Could anyone use an extra team member?
explanation: Trực tiếp xin tham gia nhóm một cách lịch sự.

question: Câu 47: Emily: Can you submit the draft... by the end of today? Mark: __________ (confused about the deadline)
options: Okay, but I thought the draft was due next week, not today.
I need more details about the proposal to complete it.
I'll send you the draft by the end of the week instead.
Sure, I'll have it ready for you by the end of today.
explanation: Thể hiện sự bối rối về deadline một cách lịch sự.

question: Câu 48: Which statement expresses an opinion?
options: The restaurant has the best pizza in town.
The restaurant's menu includes a variety of international cuisines.
The restaurant is located on Main Street.
The restaurant is known for its exceptional customer service.
explanation: “the best” là quan điểm cá nhân.

question: Câu 49: You've noticed that the office printer often jams when printing large documents. What is the likely cause?
options: The printer is outdated and needs to be replaced.
The printer is not set up correctly for large document printing.
The printer is low on ink and needs to be refilled.
The paper being used is not suitable for the printer.
explanation: Giấy không phù hợp thường gây kẹt khi in tài liệu dày/lớn.

question: Câu 50: Which of the following situations best exemplifies being “reimbursed”?
options: Alex is upgraded to a better seat after his original reservation was overbooked.
Alex’s travel expenses are covered by the company after he submits the receipts.
Alex receives his money back for a movie ticket he bought but didn't use.
Alex is given a voucher for future purchases after returning a defective product.
explanation: reimburse = hoàn trả chi phí đã bỏ ra (công ty trả lại tiền công tác).
